title: Travel, problems & emergencies
goal: Book a room or a ticket, explain a problem, ask for help in an emergency, and use 'if … then' sentences.
intro:
Travel in the Pashtun region can be an adventure: long bus journeys over mountain passes, guesthouses (مسافرخانې) in small towns, checkpoints with ID checks, and the famous hospitality of strangers. It helps to know how to explain a problem calmly — and how to call for help if you need it.

In this unit you'll learn travel and emergency vocabulary and **conditional** sentences: که 'if' … نو 'then'.

vocab.note: Present: وړم wṛəm; perfective يوسم yósəm. Past: يې يووړ 'he took it away'.

grammar.title: Real conditions: که … نو …
grammar.body:
'If' is **که** (ka); the 'then' part can start with **نو** (no), which is often left out.

For a possible future condition, the **if-clause** uses the **subjunctive** (perfective present) and the **result** uses the **future** (به + verb):

که باران **وشي**، نو زه **به** نه ځم 'if it rains, I won't go'
که وخت **ولرم**، نو **به** درشم 'if I have time, I'll come to you'

For general truths and habits, both halves can be in the present: که ناروغ يم، کور کې پاتې کېږم 'if I'm ill, I stay at home'. With commands: که ستونزه وي، ما ته زنګ ووهه 'if there's a problem, call me'.

**که نه** means 'if not / otherwise': ژر شه، که نه بس به لاړ شي 'hurry, otherwise the bus will leave'.

examples.native: که پاسپورټ ورک شي، سفارت ته لاړ شه.
examples.roman: ka pāsporṭ wrak shi, sifārát ta lāṛ sha.
examples.en: If your passport gets lost, go to the embassy.

examples.native: که لار خوندي نه وي، نو موږ به نه ځو.
examples.roman: ka lār xwandí na wi, no muẓ ba na dzu.
examples.en: If the road isn't safe, we won't go.

examples.native: که مرستې ته اړتيا لرې، ما ته ووايه.
examples.roman: ka mráste ta aṛtiyā́ lare, mā ta wə́wāya.
examples.en: If you need help, tell me.

examples.native: که ژر لاړ شو، په وخت به ورسېږو.
examples.roman: ka zhər lāṛ shu, pə waxt ba wə́raseẓu.
examples.en: If we go soon, we'll arrive on time.

examples.native: ژر شه، که نه الوتکه به لاړه شي.
examples.roman: zhər sha, ka na alwatə́ka ba lā́ṛa shi.
examples.en: Hurry up, or the plane will go.

grammar.title: Unreal conditions with وای
grammar.body:
For situations that are **not true** or **didn't happen** ('if I were …', 'if you had told me …'), Pashto uses the particle **وای** (wāy) in both halves, often with the past participle:

که تا ما ته **ويلي وای**، زه به **راغلی وای** 'if you had told me, I would have come'
که زه پوه **وای**، دا به مې نه **وای** کړی 'if I had known, I wouldn't have done this'

Note the ergative in the if-clause: 'tell' is transitive, so 'you' is تا. For 'if I were you': که زه ستا پر ځای **وای** … 'if I were in your place …'.

You don't need to produce these yet — but recognising وای will help you understand regrets, advice and stories.

examples.native: که زه ستا پر ځای وای، پوليسو ته به تللی وای.
examples.roman: ka zə stā pər dzāy wāy, políso ta ba tlə́lay wāy.
examples.en: If I were you, I would have gone to the police.

examples.native: که زه شتمن وای، يو موټر به مې اخيستی وای.
examples.roman: ka zə shatmán wāy, yaw moṭár ba me axistáy wāy.
examples.en: If I were rich, I would have bought a car.

examples.native: که وختي راغلی وای، بس به دې نيولی وای.
examples.roman: ka waxtí rāġə́lay wāy, bas ba de niwə́lay wāy.
examples.en: If you had come early, you would have caught the bus.

dialogue.title: A lost bag
dialogue.setting: Anna arrives at a guesthouse in Jalalabad after a long bus journey and discovers her bag is missing.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.native: السلام عليکم. تاسو خالي کوټه لرئ؟
lines.roman: assalā́mu ʿaláykum. tāso xālí kóṭa lárəy?
lines.en: Hello. Do you have a free room?

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.native: وعليکم السلام. هو، لرو. ستاسو تذکره يا پاسپورټ؟
lines.roman: wa ʿaláykum assalā́m. ho, láru. stāso tazkirá yā pāsporṭ?
lines.en: Hello. Yes, we do. Your ID or passport, please?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.native: اوه… زما کوچنی بکس ورک شوی! پاسپورټ مې په هغه کې و.
lines.roman: oh… zmā kuchnáy baks wrak shə́way! pāsporṭ me pə haġə́ ke wə.
lines.en: Oh… my small bag is missing! My passport was in it.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.native: مه وېرېږئ. بکس مو چېرته وروستی ځل وليد؟
lines.roman: ma weréẓəy. baks mo chérta wrustáy dzal wə́lid?
lines.en: Don't worry. Where did you last see your bag?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.native: په بس کې. شايد په بس کې پاتې شوی وي.
lines.roman: pə bas ke. shāyád pə bas ke pā́te shə́way wi.
lines.en: On the bus. Maybe it was left on the bus.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.native: که په بس کې وي، نو موږ به يې پيدا کړو. زه د اډې شمېره لرم.
lines.roman: ka pə bas ke wi, no muẓ ba ye paydā́ kṛu. zə də áḍe shmerá lárəm.
lines.en: If it's on the bus, we'll find it. I have the bus stand's number.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.native: ډېره مننه! که پيدا نه شي، څه وکړم؟
lines.roman: ḍéra manə́na! ka paydā́ na shi, tsə wə́kṛəm?
lines.en: Thank you so much! If it isn't found, what should I do?

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.native: بيا به پوليسو ته او ستاسو سفارت ته زنګ ووهو. خو اول دلته کېنئ، چای وڅښئ.
lines.roman: biyā́ ba políso ta aw stāso sifārát ta zang wə́wahu. xo awwál dálta kénəy, chāy wə́tsṣəy.
lines.en: Then we'll call the police and your embassy. But first sit down here and have some tea.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.native: زيری! بکس مو پيدا شو، چلوونکی يې اوس راوړي.
lines.roman: zéray! baks mo paydā́ shu, chalawúnkay ye os rāwṛí.
lines.en: (Twenty minutes later) Good news! Your bag's been found — the driver is bringing it now.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.native: الحمدلله! تاسو ډېر مهربان ياست. خدای دې خير درکړي.
lines.roman: alhamdulillā́h! tāso ḍer mehrabā́n yāst. xudā́y de xayr dárkṛi.
lines.en: Thank God! You're very kind. God bless you.

culture: In much of the Pashtun region, carry your passport or **تذکره** with you at all times — police and army checkpoints are common on main roads. Emergency numbers differ: in Pakistan dial 15 for police and 1122 for rescue/ambulance (in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa); in Afghanistan 119 for police and 102 for ambulance — but in practice, local people will often help first. Under the tradition of **ننواتې** (nanawatai), anyone who asks a Pashtun household for protection is traditionally given it, and travellers in trouble usually find strangers going out of their way to help. **زيری** (zéray) means 'good news', and the person who brings it is traditionally rewarded.

tip.title: If …, then …: که … نو …
tip.body:
- **که** 'if' + perfective, then **به** + verb for what will happen: که باران **وشي**، کور کې **به** پاتې شو.
- **نو** 'then' can start the second half, or be left out.
- With a command, no به: که وخت لرې، **راشه**.
- **که نه** = otherwise.

sentences.roman: ka ṭikáṭ na wi, sabā́ ba lāṛ shu.

sentences.native: که سبا باران وشي، نو به کور کې پاتې شو.

sentences.en: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.

tip.title: 'If I had …': وای
tip.body:
- For things that **didn't** happen, both halves take **وای**: که زه پوه **وای** … 'if I had known …'.
- The result: **به** + past participle + **وای**: زه به راغلی وای 'I would have come'.
- With a transitive verb the doer is ما / تا: که تا زنګ وهلی وای ….
- For now it's enough to recognise it in regrets and advice.

sentences.native: که تا ما ته زنګ وهلی وای، زه به درغلی وای.
sentences.roman: ka tā mā ta zang wahə́lay wāy, zə ba dárġəlay wāy.
sentences.en: If you had called me, I'd have come to you.

sentences.native: که زه پوه وای، ما به دا کار نه وای کړی.
sentences.roman: ka zə poh wāy, mā ba dā kār na wāy kaṛay.
sentences.en: If I'd known, I wouldn't have done this.

sentences.native: که ستونزه نه وای، زه به درغلی وای.
sentences.roman: ka stúnza na wāy, zə ba dárġəlay wāy.
sentences.en: If there hadn't been a problem, I'd have come to you.

sentences.native: که هوا ښه وای، موږ به ميلې ته تللي وای.
sentences.roman: ka hawā́ ṣa wāy, muẓ ba méle ta tlə́li wāy.
sentences.en: If the weather had been good, we'd have gone on a picnic.

sentences.native: که هغه ډاکټر ته تللی وای، اوس به جوړ وای.
sentences.roman: ka haġá ḍākṭár ta tlə́lay wāy, os ba joṛ wāy.
sentences.en: If he had gone to the doctor, he'd be well now.

sentences.native: که ژباړن وای، ښه به وای.
sentences.roman: ka zhbāṛán wāy, ṣə ba wāy.
sentences.en: It would have been good to have an interpreter. (lit. if there had been an interpreter)

sentences.native: ستونزه څه ده؟
sentences.roman: stúnza tsə da?

sentences.native: که پوه نه شې، زه به يې درته پوه کړم.
sentences.roman: ka poh na she, zə ba ye dərta poh kṛəm.
